title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electrostatic energy W = 3Q^2/(5R).

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct estimate for the radius R = 3.88 fm.

title: Correct Integration
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up and evaluate the integrals for the electrostatic energy calculation.

title: Use of Mirror Nuclei
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the mass difference to the electrostatic energy difference in the context of mirror nuclei.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the energy equations.

title: Charge Values
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that the correct charge values (Z1 and Z2) are used in the calculations.
